Try Our Sandbox Get pricing By submitting this form, I confirm that I have read and agree to Auvik’s privacy policy and applicable legal terms . FAQs What devices count toward Auvik pricing? Auvik pricing is based on the devices you manage with our IT management software. With Auvik, we will tailor a plan that includes your network devices, infrastructure devices, and edge devices to meet your specific needs. Many devices in Auvik, such as wireless access points, printers, uninterrupted power supplies, and more, are free and do not count towards your licensing. Does Auvik monitor devices for free? Yes. Auvik only bills for the network devices, infrastructure devices, and edge devices you license, and will monitor devices such as wireless access points, uninterrupted power supplies, printers, network accessible storage, and other devices for free. Are volume discounts available? Yes. Does Auvik have pricing plans for MSPs? Yes! Auvik is a proud partner of thousands of MSPs, and has pricing packages specifically built for MSPs. Does Auvik offer a perpetual license? No, Auvik is offered exclusively as a software-as-a-service. Do you offer a free trial? Yes! Try Our Sandbox Features Discovery & Inventory Customizable Alerting Network Mapping Configuration Management Advanced Netflow Monitoring & Troubleshooting Network Security AI Troubleshooting Agent See All Integrations Industries For MSPs MSP Overview Discovery & Inventory Monitoring & Troubleshooting Lifecycle Management Root Cause Analysis All Industries Manufacturing Sports & Entertainment Education Financial Services State & Local Government Healthcare Retail Agentic AI Pricing Resources Resources Blog Webinars & Events Research & Reports Use Cases Case Studies Training & Certification Knowledge Base & Support Compare Auvik SolarWinds PRTG LogicMonitor Domotz ManageEngine Login Try Auvik Free Auvik is building the future of AI-powered IT operations Auvik’s AI-driven IT management platform simplifies IT operations so teams can focus on what matters most. The key is absolute simplicity: seamless deployment, intuitive contextual AI, and effortless automation. The result is faster troubleshooting, proactive resolution, and more time for IT teams to focus on strategic priorities. The result: An AI-driven IT management platform that combines real-time infrastructure data with intelligent agents to help IT teams understand what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what to do next. Autonomous IT Operations Seamless deployment Agentic operations Effortless automation About Auvik Auvik was founded in 2011 by Alex Hoff, Marc Morin, and David Yach with a simple belief: no matter how technology evolves, the network remains the foundation that keeps businesses running. As cloud, SaaS, and distributed work transformed IT, they saw a growing challenge. Networks were becoming more complex, while IT teams had less visibility into the systems they relied on every day. From the beginning, Auvik’s vision was captured in three words: See, Tell, Do. First, help IT teams see their networks through automated discovery, mapping, and monitoring. Then, tell them what matters through intelligent insights and alerts. Over time, as Auvik expanded across thousands of customer environments, it built a unique foundation of network intelligence. Today, Auvik helps MSPs and IT teams manage more than 100,000 networks worldwide. That foundation now powers Auvik’s next chapter: using automation and AI to help IT teams move from seeing and understanding problems to solving them. Our Vision A future where IT operations are autonomous, simple, and secure. Our Mission To simplify IT operations so teams can focus on what matters most. buttons.text: Doug Murray is the Chief Executive Officer of Auvik where he drives company strategy, culture, and growth. Murray has over 25 years of network and security industry experience, including two years as the CEO of cloud cyber security company Valtix (acquired by Cisco), as well as seven years as CEO of SDN pioneer Big Switch Networks (acquired by Arista Networks). He previously held leadership positions at Juniper Networks, Sun Microsystems and AT&T, and was a finalist for the EY Entrepreneur of the Year Northern California in 2017. Doug holds a BA in History from Colgate University and an MBA from Johns Hopkins University. " data-auvikway=" Favorite Auvik Way principle? Wow Our Customers. 		function getCookie(name){
			var cookies = document.cookie.split("; ");
			for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
				var cookie = cookies[i].split("=");
				if (cookie[0] === name) {
					return cookie[1] || "";
				}
			}
			return "";
		}

		function checkCookieConsent(category){

			if (!getCookie("CookieConsent")){
				return true;
			}

			var cookies = document.cookie.split("; ");
			for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
				var cookie = cookies[i].split("=");
				if (cookie[0] === "CookieConsent" && cookies[i].indexOf("CookieConsent=") !== -1) {

					var ccIndex = cookies[i].indexOf("CookieConsent=");
					var cookieValue = cookies[i].substring(ccIndex + 14);

					cookieValue = decodeURIComponent(cookieValue);
					// console.log("--------------- decodedValue: " + cookieValue);

					if (cookieValue.indexOf(category + ":false") !== -1){
						return false;
					} else {
						return true;
					}

				}
			}
			return true;
		}

				var expiryDate = new Date().getTime() + expiryPeriod;
				return {
					value: value,

				var isGclidValid = storedGclid && new Date().getTime() < storedGclid.expiryDate;

Auvik makes network monitoring and management seamless for finance industry professionals. Banks, credit unions, and insurance IT teams can troubleshoot faster, monitor performance and automate backups with confidence. Automated Device Discovery Discover every device on your network automatically with our device management software. Map devices and connections in real time using protocols like CDP and LLDP. Bandwidth monitoring and capacity planning Easily identify bandwidth hogs down to the user, application, and protocol. Make data-driven decisions on budget and vulnerability management with key info like make & model, firmware versions, support contracts, software versions, and security updates. Identify devices nearing end-of-life or support expiration across your infrastructure, all from one dashboard. Fault Detection and Management With our swift fault detection, you receive immediate alerts when network issues arise, helping you stay on top of problems as they happen.
